sources.frozen_excerpt: Self-description: Hobbyist Pythonista; good at poking systems to find bugs; learning to create/polish tools. Claims author/maintainer roles for labeille/lafleur, maintainer/republisher for fusil, long CPython contribution/triage history, and contributions across parts of the Python ecosystem.
Owned public non-fork repository names at snapshot; names are discovery/provenance only and must not be treated as skill evidence by themselves.

labeille: real-world PyPI test-suite runner for JIT-enabled CPython; resolve/run/bisect, benchmark, free-threaded and C-extension compatibility workflows; early alpha. README notes package enrichment may be manual or AI-assisted.
lafleur: coverage-guided evolutionary fuzzer for CPython JIT; JIT-specific mutators, adaptive scheduling, session fuzzing, introspection, campaign aggregation and crash triage. Spun out from fusil.
fusil is explicitly a revival of Victor Stinner's framework; current active scope is Python fuzzing for CPython/C extensions/JIT/OOM, with legacy non-Python fuzzers out of scope.
Catalog reports 464 bugs across 28 external projects and separates findings/bugs/artifacts. Explicit disclosure: catalog + tooling assembled with Claude Code (Opus 4.8).
Claude Code plugin for CPython C review with 23 analysis agents, regex/tree-sitter detectors, campaign slicing and reproduction workflows; scanners produce candidates and agents confirm/dismiss.

39 unique CPython OOM bug reports with reproducers/backtraces/root-cause writeups. Explicit attribution: Claude Code works alongside maintainer; maintainer reviews and re-reproduces every finding before disclosure.
TSan triage/dedupe catalog structure; README says nothing is catalogued yet and repository has just been stood up for next phase.

Subject-authored CPython crash report for reversed(dict) OOB/segfault with reproducer, source-path comparison, history analysis and suggested fix. Disclosure: found with cpython-review-toolkit; reduced, reproduced and drafted with Claude Code assistance.

Subject-authored umbrella issue for 15 free-threading data races found using fusil --tsan. Explicit disclosure: Claude Code drafted reports/reduced reproducers; every reproducer was re-run/re-verified by hand and every root cause checked against current source.
